full_details: Church was ordinary. Master Thwaite did not number his heads. At dinner the loaf was a penny and a finger and a half short of the notch, and not set on a pan. You said the second act is shut, and that the third was begun yesterday on half a sheet, and not told at this table. You paid threepence. At four you wrote the letter. You answered in her order and left the barn blank. The sleeve went in as the seamstress's part. The sheet waits for Thursday.
one_sentence: You heard a plain sermon, sat at her table for threepence, and wrote home.
title: Wrote home on a clean sheet
